title: I Told Them to Sell Their Website. They Said No.
transcript: This couple could have sold their website for life-changing money, but they made a bold choice. >> If your traffic is 70% in Google, you've seen what happens. [music] We've seen people's businesses get wiped out before. Huge mega site goes from 3.8 million monthly organics down to 592,000. They've just lost like 5 years in traffic. I would personally be looking to exit. >> I think we still feel like this is just [music] the beginning. I like to think of decisions of like if I got to my deathbed, how would I feel about this? >> Yeah. >> And if I sold just because I was fearful that we would lose everything, I would not feel congruent with that. >> They'd rather bet on themselves, risk it all, rather than sell out and walk away not knowing what could have been. >> All of this can go away tomorrow, and I think this is the unfortunate part of having an SEO business.
